referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This process models deconstruction and end-of-life treatment for 1 meter of installed sewer infrastructure with GFRP (glass fibre reinforced plastic) pipe. SN 10000-20000, DN 300, profile 4 according to SIA 190. Trench depth: 3 meters. This process includes the deconstruction phase (C1), transport phase (C2), treatment/ recycling phase (C3), and final disposal phase (C4) for 1 meter of sewer system with GFRP pipe, DN 300, profile 4. The operation of similar types of building machines across different processes is aggregated to one process.
